OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: The scope (MIME types) handled by the connector.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_AUTO.description: Whether the connector should run automatically when an entity is created or updated.

MISP_IMPORT_FILE_IMPORT_FROM_DATE.description: Optional lower-bound date used when importing MISP events.

MISP_IMPORT_FILE_CREATE_REPORTS.description: Create a report for each imported MISP event.

MISP_IMPORT_FILE_REPORT_TYPE.description: Report type to use for imported MISP events.

MISP_IMPORT_FILE_CREATE_OBJECT_OBSERVABL.description: Create text observables for MISP objects.

MISP_IMPORT_FILE_CREATE_TAGS_AS_LABELS.description: Create MISP tags as OpenCTI labels.

MISP_IMPORT_FILE_GUESS_THREATS_FROM_TAGS.description: Try to guess threats (threat actor, intrusion set, malware, etc.) from MISP tags when they are present in OpenCTI.

MISP_IMPORT_FILE_AUTHOR_FROM_TAGS.description: Map creator:XX=YY so the event author is derived from MISP tags.

MISP_IMPORT_FILE_IMPORT_TO_IDS_NO_SCORE.description: Score applied to the indicator/observable when the attribute 'to_ids' flag is false.

MISP_IMPORT_FILE_IMPORT_UNSUPPORTED_OBSE.description: Import unsupported observables as x_opencti_text just with the value.

MISP_IMPORT_FILE_IMPORT_WITH_ATTACHMENTS.description: Try to import a PDF file from the attachment attribute.
